reviewedTemplateChanges: Add a shared non-killing install/uninstall guard macro that reports/refuses with exit code 2.

unsupportedUpgradeBoundary: The pinned template's normal upgrade page may invoke a pre-existing uninstaller through ExecWait. Previously installed uninstaller bytes are not replaced by this template and may retain a stock name-based killing branch; those legacy upgrade paths remain unsupported until separately qualified.
